KP07-P16-code-center.name: KP07-P16-code-center
KP07-P16-code-center.text:
```python
import numpy as np
r=K.mean(axis=1); g=K.mean()
Kc=K-r[:,None]-r[None,:]+g
```

KP07-P16-code-eigen.name: KP07-P16-code-eigen
KP07-P16-code-eigen.text:
```python
ell,V=np.linalg.eigh(Kc)
tol=1e-10*max(1,np.max(np.abs(ell)))
if ell.min() < -tol: raise ValueError("not PSD")
good=np.flatnonzero(ell>tol); j=good[-1]
v=V[:,j]; i=np.flatnonzero(np.abs(v)>tol)[0]
v*=np.sign(v[i])
alpha=v/np.sqrt(ell[j])
```

KP07-P16-code-new.name: KP07-P16-code-new
KP07-P16-code-new.text:
```python
kstar=np.array([4.,4.,0.,0.])
kc=kstar-kstar.mean()-r+g
zstar=alpha@kc
# direction sign was fixed in the eigen phase
```
